notes:
- DT Ducker is now actually included. It was announced in 1.0.12 but accidentally left out of that installer and update — this release ships it. The Ducker is a drawable sidechain-pump: sketch the volume shape with movable start/middle/end points, shift-click the graph to add more, and bend any segment Ableton-style. Runs tempo-synced (quarter-note pump out of the box) or one-shot from an external sidechain input — feed it a kick and the pattern fires on every hit. Fresh instances open on the "Caleb's Default" pump.
- Pro Tools (AAX): effects now appear under their proper insert-menu categories (Dynamics, EQ, Reverb, Modulation, etc.) instead of all under "Other," and every effect shows its "DT …" name (EQ, the M/S splitter, and the exciter previously dropped the prefix).
- No other functional changes from 1.0.12 — same effects and sound.
